source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB counterpart establishes standard App 0x06/0x57 capability read.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart identifies standard 0x57 read and FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats interface matrix/reference as Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Read each approved BMC system-interface capability set and validate interface version, message-size and transaction features without changing interface state.
original_method: Issue standard App 0x06/0x57 for the approved interface type selectors, decode the interface-specific response and compare the Project capability matrix.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies applicable interface types and expected capabilities once; bounded reads need no action confirmation.
safety_requirements: Do not equate supported with enabled

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative after standard 0x57 OOB history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw App 0x06/0x57 with explicit interface-type selector and pinned type-specific parser.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate only approved interface types, validate each 0x57 response, decode version and size/SSIF capabilities, compare the platform matrix and prove no state mutation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standard bounded read guidance without altering Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Capability reporting does not prove interface enablement, authorization or functional traffic.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Using the wrong type schema can misreport limits and drive unsafe configuration assumptions.

project_override_considerations: Vendor inventory may substitute only if it preserves each interface type and all capability fields.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and requests log clearing; GPT V2 treats missing Project selector/schema/reference as permanent BLOCKED despite standard 0x57 history.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard read is defined; interface selectors, parsers and expected matrix are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates advertised capability from enabled/effective state and requires per-interface schema validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a bounded read-only command with deterministic per-interface decoding. With the interface matrix and parser supplied, it is safely automated and does not require user confirmation.
